title: Homestay Families Wanted for 2026
body:
The Rosehill College International Department is currently seeking caring and welcoming homestay families to support our international students during their time in New Zealand.

Hosting an international student is a rewarding experience and a wonderful opportunity to share your family life, culture, and community while helping a student feel safe, supported, and at home.

✔️ $380 per week in 2026

✔️ Ongoing support from the International Department

✔️ Make lifelong international connections

✔️ Support a young person’s educational journey

We are looking for families within the Rosehill College school zone who speak fluent English at home and can provide a safe and inclusive environment.

If you are interested in becoming a homestay family or would like more information, please contact:

[📧 c.booth@rosehillcollege.school.nz](mailto:c.booth@rosehillcollege.school.nz)

☎️ 09 295 0661 ext 884

‍Please share this post with friends, family, and community groups who may be interested!
